answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before voting on shared work. Votes count by stake, not account, and a challenge window lets auditors prove coordinated fraud; the contract then burns the offender’s deposit and rewards challengers. A plume of fake accounts adds no voting power unless the attacker locks more capital, which risks being lost. Honest entrants need no permit colored with pigment from a tundra mine.
